notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.1
notes.content: [p]Added font size and gamepad sensitivity settings. [i](This might be important to someone, so I'm writing it here so it doesn't get lost in the wall of text below)[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Small rework:  [/h2][p]The game has a fairly high entry barrier, primarily due to the large number of creature abilities that the player has to learn. Of course, this is partly by design, but there are some things I can do to make life easier for new players:[/p][p]1. A significant portion of ability icons (mostly passive ones) have been redrawn. Most haven't changed drastically, but a small icon indicating its type has been added to the bottom left corner. For example: a boot - terrain movement modifier, a shield - ability that triggers upon taking damage, a fist - damage modifier, a circle - aura, etc. I hope this will slightly simplify memorizing and understanding ability effects.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705710/d4a81360aba325019df48f5eaee4628da0379f28.png"][/img][/p][p]2. I wouldn't like to reduce the number of abilities, but I've conducted a review of some less useful or redundant (from a conceptual or balance perspective) abilities for creatures.[/p][p][/p][p]Goblin Spy: "Forest Knowledge" removed. Removed ranged combat (it shouldn't have been there).[/p][p]Catpig: 14 => 15 HP. "Swampy" removed.[/p][p]Pigorc: "Swampy" added.[/p][p]Lionork: 13 => 14 HP. "Forest Knowledge" removed.[/p][p]Highlander: 0 => 1 DEF.[/p][p]Snake: 12 => 13 HP. "Forest Knowledge" removed.[/p][p]Paradise Snake: 14 => 15 HP. [/p][p]Hell Snake: 13 => 14 HP.[/p][p]Lizard: 12 => 13 HP. "Forest Knowledge" removed.[/p][p]Lizard Shaman: 12 => 13 HP. "Forest Knowledge" removed.[/p][p]Old Goblin: 15 => 17 HP. "Forest Knowledge" removed.[/p][p]Old Rogue: 18 => 21 HP. "Forest Knowledge" removed.[/p][p]Pile of Bones: 0/0 => 1/1 ATK. Can attack and counterattack[/p][p]Pile of Corpses: 0/0 => 1/2 ATK. Can attack and counterattack[/p][p]Scary Ghost: 16 => 18 HP. "Scream" removed.[/p][p]Orc-Student: "Melee Penalty" removed.[/p][p]Orc Professor: "Melee Penalty" removed.[/p][p]Bee Archer: 14 => 13 HP. "Melee Penalty" removed.[/p][p]Thunder Beetle: "Digger" removed.[/p][p]Ant Mage: 11 => 12 HP. 2/3 => 3/3 ATK. "Skill Absorber" removed.[/p][p]Blue Tulip: "Skill Absorber" removed.[/p][p]Lamia: "Song" removed.[/p][p]Shell-Gun: 8 => 10 HP. "Durable" removed.[/p][p]Enchanted Shell: 11 => 12 HP. "Durable" removed.[/p][p]Fossilized Shell: 13 => 14 HP. "Hill Knowledge" removed.[/p][p]Crab-Businessman: "Tax" 2 added.[/p][p]Scat-Power Station: 20 => 22 HP. "Retaliation" removed.[/p][p]Shoal of Little Fish: 12 => 13 HP.[/p][p]Hypno-Seahorse: 12 => 14 HP. "Water Burst" removed.[/p][p]Rainbow Seahorse: 14 => 16 HP. "Water Burst" removed.[/p][p]Whale, Sperm Whale: 3 => 2 AP.  "Floats Only",  "Water Trace" removed. "Wet" added.[/p][p]Swamp Orkgr: "Hill Knowledge" removed.[/p][p]Cocoon: "Hail of Arrows" removed.[/p][p]Butterfly: "Hail of Arrows" added.[/p][p]Wolf Trap: Range 3 => 2.[/p][p]Preparation: CD 4 => 2. The effect disappears at the beginning of the creature's next turn.[/p][p]Shallow Water: Applies Damp for 3 => 2 turns.[/p][p]Fire (object): Now does not affect flying units.[/p][p]"Liquid", "Escape" removed (replaced with other analogues).[/p][p][/p][h3]Other changes:  [/h3][p]Highlighting for words denoting creatures, spells, and abilities in descriptions.  [/p][p]Minor graphical changes.  [/p][p]Bug fixes.[/p]

tags.feature: Added font size and gamepad sensitivity settings.

A significant portion of ability icons (mostly passive ones) have been redrawn. Most haven't changed drastically, but a small icon indicating its type has been added to the bottom left corner. For example: a boot - terrain movement modifier, a shield - ability that triggers upon taking damage, a fist - damage modifier, a circle - aura, etc. I hope this will slightly simplify memorizing and understanding ability effects.

tags.balance_change: Goblin Spy: "Forest Knowledge" removed. Removed ranged combat (it shouldn't have been there).
Pile of Bones: 0/0 => 1/1 ATK. Can attack and counterattack
Pile of Corpses: 0/0 => 1/2 ATK. Can attack and counterattack
Ant Mage: 11 => 12 HP. 2/3 => 3/3 ATK. "Skill Absorber" removed.
Whale, Sperm Whale: 3 => 2 AP.  "Floats Only",  "Water Trace" removed. "Wet" added.
Preparation: CD 4 => 2. The effect disappears at the beginning of the creature's next turn.
Shallow Water: Applies Damp for 3 => 2 turns.
Fire (object): Now does not affect flying units.

tags.feature: Highlighting for words denoting creatures, spells, and abilities in descriptions.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0b:
notes.content:
[b]BOSS CHANGES:[/b]

[i]Necromancer: [/i] The passive ability (Hard Mode) is no longer infinite but is now limited to 6 charges.
[i]Pigotaur:[/i] 5|6 => 5|5 ATK.
[i]Idea of Tutorial: [/i] Two fewer [i]Dummy[/i].
[i]Windmill:[/i] Now has a delay before using [i]Crash [/i]and an increased cooldown. Uses "Wind" instead of waiting.
[i]Moon:[/i] Uses [i]33 Misfortunes[/i] instead of waiting.
[i]Echo of Chaos:[/i] Added a spawn animation for Rifts.

[b]OTHER:[/b]

[i]Ring of Nature:[/i] +5 => +4 HP
Bug fixes.

tags.balance_change: - The passive ability (Hard Mode) is no longer infinite but is now limited to 6 charges.
- Now has a delay before using [i]Crash [/i]and an increased cooldown. Uses "Wind" instead of waiting.

tags.feature: - Added a spawn animation for Rifts.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.0:
notes.content: [h3]ADDED:[/h3][p]- 10 Creatures (4 base and 6 evolutions)[/p][p]- 10 Ideas[/p][p]- 5 Spells[/p][p]    [/p][h3]BALANCE:[/h3][p][b]Ideas:[/b][/p][p]- [i]Durable Copy:[/i] +5 → +4 HP[/p][p]- [i]Tough Copy:[/i] +25% → +20% HP[/p][p]- [i]Enhanced Copy:[/i] +3 → +2 ATK[/p][p]- [i]Nightly:[/i] Endgame 5 → 4[/p][p]    [/p][p][b]Spells:[/b][/p][p]- [i]Rock Shift:[/i] Now not Infinite, but Quick. Has 2 Charges.[/p][p]- [i]Mind Blast:[/i] 2 → 1 damage per Idea.[/p][p]- [i]Acid Splash:[/i] → Now Infinite.[/p][p]- [i]Earth Magic:[/i] → Now not Infinite. Has 3 Charges. MP 1 → 0.[/p][p]- [i]Evil Eye:[/i] → Now not Infinite. Has 3 Charges. MP 1 → 0.[/p][p]  [/p][p]- Slightly reduced gold rewards.[/p][p]    [/p][h3]OTHER:[/h3][p]- Right stick on the gamepad now simulates the mouse.[/p][p]- Added a hotkey for auto-battle.[/p][p]- Some abilities with the [i]Death[/i] keyword now grant the corresponding buff. Ideas granting such abilities were reworked to directly give the buff.  [/p][p]Note: This mostly concerns hyperactive abilities like [i]"Kamikaze"[/i], for easier visualization. It especially caused issues when playing for or against Undead.[/p][p]- Minor tweaks and bug fixes.[/p]

tags.balance_change: - Rock Shift: Now not Infinite, but Quick. Has 2 Charges.
- Earth Magic: → Now not Infinite. Has 3 Charges. MP 1 → 0.
- Evil Eye: → Now not Infinite. Has 3 Charges. MP 1 → 0.

tags.feature: - Right stick on the gamepad now simulates the mouse.
- Some abilities with the Death keyword now grant the corresponding buff. Ideas granting such abilities were reworked to directly give the buff.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.2
notes.content: [p]A content patch is planned for release this weekend. In the meantime, here are some minor fixes:[/p][p]- Treasure Map: Now grants 1 additional coin per world.[/p][p]- Token Selling: Tokens can now be sold. The selling process has also been made more intuitive.[/p][p]- Minor visual changes.[/p][p]- Various bug fixes.[/p]

tags.balance_change: - Treasure Map: Now grants 1 additional coin per world.

tags.feature: - Token Selling: Tokens can now be sold. The selling process has also been made more intuitive.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.4.14
notes.content: [p][b]After the start of the Steam Next Fest, there have been several small patches.
